status.note: Additional R1 visual vocabulary only. It supplements, and does not replace, the accepted V3 six-layer style reference. Production derivation still requires an accepted full-map composition master.

canvas.co_registration: all four outputs share identical canvas and origin with the accepted R1 V3 reference

relationship.integration_rule: Keep each PNG independent. If reviewed as useful vocabulary, place it at its matching parallax depth without changing scene topology or collider authority.

generation.source_background_contract: uniform technical chroma key; no baked Godot-owned lighting or atmosphere

layers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: additional transparent-source parallax layer for the R1 drowned-rooftops biome, L01 ultra-far silhouettes, wide 16:9 game environment plate
Input images: Image 1 is the user-accepted R1 V3 style and composition reference. Image 2 is the existing R1 L01 coverage reference; complement it without copying or replacing its clusters.
Primary request: generate ONLY one additional L01 plane of very distant drowned-city rooftop silhouettes for R1. This is a supplementary layer that will be converted to alpha and stacked independently with the existing six-layer set.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF technical chroma-key background from edge to edge.
Subject: four to six disconnected, low-frequency silhouettes of old European rooftop blocks, short chimney groups, water tanks, sparse antenna frames and broken parapet rhythms. Keep them broad, simplified, quiet and clearly farther away than all structural/detail layers. Use different contours from Image 2. Preserve a large calm open swimming corridor through the middle of the canvas; clusters may enter from side edges but must not join into a continuous floor, ceiling or navigable platform.
Style/medium: strongly flat orthographic 2D side-scroller environment art, restrained painterly silhouette edges, muted blue-teal material around #1D5261, very low internal detail and low contrast. No perspective, no vanishing point, no horizon line, no 3D extrusion, no cast shadow, no bright rim or white outline.
Composition/framing: wide landscape matching the reference aspect ratio; all clusters share one far-depth class. Generous separation between clusters. Do not reproduce existing L01 placement one-to-one.
Lighting/mood: neutral unlit material reference; Godot will provide lighting and atmosphere.
Background extraction contract: the background must be exactly one uniform #FF00FF color with no gradient, texture, haze, shadow, floor plane, vignette or color variation. Do not use magenta in the subject. Crisp antialiased boundaries and no halo.
Constraints: no text, labels, borders, panel divisions, watermark, HUD, diver, characters, creatures, landmark hero object, gameplay item, lamps, glow, reflections, fog, caustics, light rays, particles, bubbles, refraction or global color grading. Do not imply new collision or topology.
Avoid: medium-detail masonry, floating props, collider-adjacent terrain skin, foreground occluders, a finished composite scene.
layers.qa: pass; five broad disconnected distant silhouette clusters, open center, no visible magenta

layers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: additional parallax source plane for R1 L03 mid-depth drifting city debris, landscape game bitmap to be converted into a transparent straight-sRGBA PNG
Input images: Image 1 is the accepted R1 V3 composite and defines only the muted drowned-rooftop palette, controlled painterly material language and strong flat 2D treatment. Image 2 is the existing R1 L03 layer and defines only scale, sparse spacing and depth-class vocabulary; create distinct alternate silhouettes rather than copying its objects.
Primary request: Generate EXACTLY TEN fully disconnected, non-interactive drowned-city debris objects, all isolated on one perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF chroma-key background. Include exactly one of each: (1) one damaged chair with a broken back slat, (2) one small simple stool, (3) one compact square empty window frame distinct from the tall frame in Image 2, (4) one narrow empty door frame, (5) one short straight gutter segment, (6) one short bent wrought-iron railing section, (7) one small irregular clay roof-tile patch distinct from Image 2, (8) one blank weathered sign fragment with absolutely no text, letters, numbers, icons or symbols, (9) one short splintered timber beam, and (10) one compact broken concrete chunk with a few exposed rebar ends.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #FF00FF technical chroma field from edge to edge. Every background pixel must be the same color: no gradient, texture, checkerboard, vignette, floor plane, shadow, reflection, halo, haze or lighting variation. Do not use #FF00FF or near-magenta anywhere inside the objects.
Style/medium: premium but unmistakably flat orthographic 2D side-scroller environment cutouts; strict front or side elevation; subdued stylized realism; clean readable silhouettes; only 2–4 broad value groups per object; restrained tactile material detail matching Image 1. Muted wet gray stone, dull oxidized iron, dark desaturated wood and dark clay tile. Color-matched antialiasing, no white outline.
Composition/framing: landscape canvas. Distribute the ten objects sparsely across two loose staggered rows with very large magenta breathing room. Every object must be fully visible, modest in size, separately countable and surrounded on all sides by clean key color. No two objects may touch, overlap, align into a chain, or share a support. Keep generous empty margins around the entire set. Do not crop any object at a canvas edge.
Lighting/mood: neutral unlit diffuse material reference, no identifiable light source.
Constraints: exactly ten objects and no additional fragments. Decorative floating debris only. No continuous platform, shelf, bridge, floor, wall, route, stepping stones, room, terrain mass, collider shape or new topology. No landmark identity or recognizable pharmacy, hotel, hospital, museum, archive, station, parking structure, grocery or ship motif. No gameplay loot, crate, pickup, objective, interactable, lamp or device.
Avoid: perspective, vanishing point, horizon, 3D extrusion, cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, bright rim, glow, emission, bloom, fog, haze, caustics, refraction, particles, bubbles, water rays, global color grading, HUD, diver, people, creatures, plants, text, labels, panel divisions, border, logo or watermark.
